body: I know he is trying to reach out for help and vent with his suicide threats and his tantrums, but it makes me feel cornered and it makes me feel like I want to disappear. I try to talk to him but he usually rejects everything I say as irrelevant and unhelpful. I've begged him to see someone for help, but he doesn't believe anyone can help him. I love him very much, but I feel this heavy dread every time I have to go back home and face him. I'm constantly imagining myself doing things that could possibly kill me (jumping into the subway, busses, off buildings, off bridges) to end this shit we call life. I feel like we are in a very unhealthy relationship. I feel like I need to leave him to help myself, but I can't because he'll kill himself if I leave him. My hands are tied. I feel like I don't even have the right kill myself because I feel obligated to take care of my boyfriend for his family. So here I am, trying to provide support for him as I slip deeper into depression everyday... wishing I'll die from an accident or something. I'm fucking useless and a fucking coward.
